request.style: English, South African isicathamiya Christmas song, a cappella male choir with a tenor lead calling and the choir answering, deep bass, soft stepping, gentle and glowing, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shepherds in the fields at night
Keeping watch over their flock
The angel of the Lord appeared
And the glory shone around them

[Chorus]
Do not be afraid
I bring you good news of great joy
For all the people
Do not be afraid

[Verse]
Unto you is born this day
In the city of David
A Savior who is Christ the Lord
You will find him in a manger

[Chorus]
Do not be afraid
I bring you good news of great joy
For all the people
Do not be afraid

[Outro]
Glory to God in the highest
